pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6.Be3 e5 7.Nb3 Be6 8.f3 Be7
pages.notes: Plan 4 had White reposition an f3-bishop that does not exist; plans 1 and 2 used 0-0 notation and a ...b5-b4 route. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4 (second wording after the reviewer noted a d7-knight does not support ...b5); British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6.Be3 e5 7.Nb3 Be6 8.f3 Be7 9.Qd2
pages.notes: Plan 4 had ...Rxc3 with no rook on the c-file; plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 route. Reworded both.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6.Be3 e5 7.Nb3 Be6 8.f3 Be7 9.Qd2 O-O 10.O-O-O Nbd7
pages.notes: Plan 3 had knights aiming for f5 with none able to get there; plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 route. Rewrote plans 2 and 3 around Nd5.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6.Be3 e5 7.Nb3 Be6 8.Qd2
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed the b3-knight via c1 to d3; plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 route. Rewrote plans 2 and 3.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6.Be3 Ng4 7.Bg5
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a g4 and h4 pawn storm with the g4-square occupied by Black's knight; plan 4 kept a pin on an f6-knight that is on g4. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6.Be3 Ng4 7.Bg5 h6 8.Bh4 g5 9.Bg3 Bg7
pages.notes: The overview called the line the Poisoned Pawn's cousin; plan 2 had ...Be7 with the bishop on g7; plan 3 called the g3-bishop light-squared; plan 1 mixed queenside castling with a queenside pawn attack. Rewrote the overview (second wording after the reviewer could not confirm a bishop-pair claim) and plans 1-3.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6.Be3 Ng4 7.Bg5 h6 8.Bh4 g5 9.Bg3 Bg7 10.Be2
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an f3, g4, h4 storm with the g4-square occupied by Black's knight; plan 3 had a ...b5-b4 route. Rewrote plans 1 and 3 around 11.Bxg4 and f3.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6.g3 e5
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted a b3-knight via c1-d3 before White has a knight on b3; plan 2 called ...b5-b4 a minority attack. Rewrote both plans; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6.g3 e5 7.Nb3
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a knight route Nd1-e3 and the overview compared the line to a Maroczy Bind. Rewrote the overview and both plans.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, 6.g3 e5 7.Nde2 b5
pages.notes: Plan 4 had ...Rc8 with the bishop on c8 and called queenside expansion a minority attack; plan 1 used 0-0. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling in the overview.
